periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward-inward relative to the snout-ear axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-shaped with a vertical-oblique length roughly 1.5 to 2 times its width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering towards the muzzle, with the lower extremity of the patch narrowing as it descends.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve along the posterior edge of the black transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band occupying approximately 40% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Substantial separation distance between pinnae, approximately equal to the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded and semicircular top boundary with high contour smoothness.
